summary: P.D.C. Visa Plus+ is a visa agency that helps with retirement, marriage, child-support Non-O and tourist visas, 90-day reports and house registration; its site gives an Udon Thani office.

facts.label: Retirement visa
facts.value: Retirement visa help for people aged 50 or older
facts.quote: If you are 50 years of age or older, P.D.C. Visa Plus+ can help you obtain a Retirement Visa.

facts.label: Marriage visa
facts.value: Marriage visa help for clients with a Thai wife
facts.quote: can help you and your Thai wife with all the required steps to obtain a Marriage Visa.

facts.label: 90-day report
facts.quote: PDC Visa Plus can help you complete your 90 Day Report

facts.label: Opening hours
facts.value: Monday to Saturday 9AM to 5PM, closed Sundays and public holidays
facts.quote: Monday thru Saturday 9AM to 5PM - Closed Sundays & Thailand Public Holidays

facts.label: Location
facts.value: Prajak Road, Preecha Market, Udon Thani
